title: Asymmetric Naming of Opposite Pairs
pattern: Defining opposite variables, parameters, or struct fields using mismatched pairs (e.g., `begin` with `last`, `first` with `end`, or `min` with `limit`).
why_bad: Departing from standard, symmetric linguistic opposites increases cognitive load and causes maintainers to misinterpret range boundaries (e.g., assuming `last` is exclusive because it is paired with `begin`).
detection: Match structs, tuples, or functions defining range limits with asymmetric opposites. Symmetric pairs are: `begin`/`end`, `first`/`last`, `min`/`max`, `locked`/`unlocked`.
